request.description: Returns `data.id` (media_id) and `data.url` (signed, short-lived for private files). 409 NOT_CONFIGURED when limits for the context are not set in app_settings.
Use `data.url` from the upload response as-is. Tampered or expired → 403 FORBIDDEN.
